role: DEV offline surrogate, entire parameter seeds held out; not unseen-terrain evaluation or deployed closed-loop selection; contact features are simulator-truth oracle

protocol.normalization: training fold only; intercept unpenalized; same folds and regularization for both models
protocol.physical_prediction_bounds: errors clipped at0 and survival score clipped0to1; no tuning
protocol.selection: predicted feasible set then speed; preserve empty set flag and evaluate fallback violations
protocol.limitations: 30 possible contexts and5 fixed parameter seeds; no hyperparameter search or new policy training
